note: The only table translating structured specs/conformance/calculator-cases.json inputs into `noble calculator` stdin lines. Expected values and categories always come from the cases file; this table never adds an expected span or value the case does not state, except the explicitly derived follow-up probes for CALC-07 `rejected_definition_installed: false`.

spelling.source: README.md, Experimental calculator: `let NAME = EXPR` or `fn NAME(P, ...)=EXPR`

define-variable-success-source: crates/noble-cli/src/calculator.rs: a `let` line formats its value before committing State and returns Outcome::Value, so the CLI prints it; a successful `fn` returns Outcome::Defined and prints nothing
echo-expectation: the printed value equals the expression when the expression is a canonical integer literal; otherwise any exact display line matches (the cases file states no value for a definition)

display.source: README.md: results print as `n/d`, or `n` when the denominator is 1
display.default: numerator when denominator is "1", else numerator/denominator

CALC-01.expect: value: display(vector.numerator, vector.denominator) in default mode

CALC-03.expect: diagnostic: vector.category (the case states no span; the observed span is recorded only)

CALC-06.input: all operations, rendered with `spelling`, form one session (one process, one stdin)
CALC-06.expect: define-variable without expected_error: echo; define-function without expected_error: silent; expected_fraction: value in default display; expected_error: diagnostic category only

CALC-09.input: vector.fraction (`n/d`) is one stdin line evaluated as an exact division

cyclic-imported-definition-graph.reason: The calculator line grammar has no import or module syntax, so an imported definition graph has no CLI spelling.

resource-capability-capture.reason: The calculator line grammar names no resources or capabilities, so a capture has no CLI spelling.

CALC-07-outcomes.otherwise: diagnostic with that category; the case states no span, so the observed span is recorded only
